authority.mandatory_stop: Stop after Step 5D development results and independent reproduction are sealed.

decision_rules.PASS: All support and advancement gates pass; label PROVISIONAL_DEVELOPMENT_CANDIDATE_NOT_VALIDATED.
decision_rules.REJECT: Support passes but one or more advancement gates fail.
decision_rules.overflow: A passing test outside the top two is recorded PASS_NOT_SHORTLISTED_CAP; it is not a provisional candidate.

bootstrap.interval: 2.5th and 97.5th Type-7 linear percentiles of finite replicate effects
bootstrap.sampling: Within each year sample its distinct selected_month_week_id clusters with replacement, preserving every selected row in a sampled cluster.
bootstrap.seed: Exact uint64 stored per test in frozen test registry

multiplicity.members: Every support-eligible preregistered test, including negative and contrary results.

permutation.block: Within year, permute whole five-weekday outcome vectors among selected_month_week_id clusters; fixed condition rows receive the permuted outcome from the same weekday slot. Missing slots remain UNKNOWN.
permutation.finite_rule: A replicate without both condition and complement binary outcomes is non-extreme and separately counted; support eligibility makes this exceptional.
permutation.seed: Exact uint64 stored per test in frozen test registry

independent_reproduction.primary: NumPy mask/vectorized block-resampling implementation over the primary Step 5C joined file.
independent_reproduction.reference: Separately coded indexed/group-loop implementation over the reference Step 5C joined file using the same frozen random schedules.
required_exact: bootstrap finite counts and percentile bounds

known_and_missing_policy.binary_known: Every constituent is known and the primary outcome is UP or DOWN.
known_and_missing_policy.constituent_known: state is not an unknown-state exclusion, epistemic_status is not UNKNOWN, quality is neither MISSING nor INVALID, and source_signature is not UNKNOWN
known_and_missing_policy.test_known: Every constituent is known and the primary outcome is UP, DOWN, or FLAT.

neutral_outcome.end: Final complete one-minute bar closing no later than 12:00 local.
neutral_outcome.flat_policy: Retain and report; exclude from binary effects and support; include in known signed-displacement median gate.
neutral_outcome.reference: Open of first complete one-minute bar opening exactly 08:01 local.
neutral_outcome.secondary_outcomes: Not loaded into the joined analysis payload and never used for selection, ranking, rescue, or rejection.
neutral_outcome.signed_displacement: final_close minus reference_open in USD per troy ounce

states.UNKNOWN: missing, incomplete, timestamp-invalid, lineage-invalid, or documented unavailable

outcome_source_and_opening.independent_extraction: For each selected row, primary reads neutral_excursions signed close plus sealed net state; reference reads SESSION_CLOSE horizon displacement and recomputes the state. They must match exactly during the one source stream.
outcome_source_and_opening.join_reproduction: Join the single sealed projection independently to primary and reference Step 5C decision files and require byte-identical joined payloads.
outcome_source_and_opening.outcome_projection: Write only key, signed displacement, UP/DOWN/FLAT/UNKNOWN, observation end, and hashed lineage; no secondary outcome is admitted to testing.
outcome_source_and_opening.single_open_rule: Stream the sealed gzip once. Inspect only metadata on unselected rows; deserialize subsequent_behaviour only for the 374 selected available keys.
outcome_source_and_opening.source: sealed V3 development case payload only

prohibited: adding retuning repairing inverting or selectively filtering a test
raw feature search or threshold search
using a secondary outcome as a gate
execution entry exit stop target sizing slippage trade PnL R or return calculation

annual.gate: At least three supported annual blocks have effect >0; no supported annual effect is <= -10 percentage points.
annual.supported: At least the stage-specific per-year condition floor (5 standalone; 4 interaction) and at least one complement binary row.

stability.leave_one_year_out: For each of four omitted years, require condition and complement binary support >0 and effect >0.
stability.median_signed_displacement: Median across every condition row with a known signed displacement, including FLAT; must be >0 for UP and <0 for DOWN.

rolling.evaluable: At least one condition and one complement binary row
rolling.window: 12 consecutive selected monthly weeks advanced one selected month at a time

stage_order.stage_1: Run and independently reproduce the complete Stage-1 family, apply BH, write and seal the complete table.
stage_order.stage_2: Run only the 124 registered two-condition tests and independently reproduce the complete family.
stage_order.stage_2_gate: Stage 2 may begin only after the Stage-1 manifest and verdict verify.

support_gates.coverage_denominator: All 188 frozen rows in the applicable session, including the documented unavailable row.
support_gates.interaction_constituent_coverage: Each constituent field separately must meet 0.70.
support_gates.support_failure: SUPPORT_FAIL; descriptive counts only; no p-value, q-value, candidate, or advancement credit.
support_gates.test_known_coverage: Joint constituent-known plus primary-outcome-known fraction must meet 0.70.
